title: Walking Dead In The City
requirements: Suitable for all physical fitness levels
The tour is only for those over 13 years old. All children must be accompanied by an adult.
We do not allow special requirements to be noted without prior approval.
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb:
Please note that this is a filming location tour and does not include admission to any studios.

Explore like a local as you enjoy a personalized walking and driving tour of 'The Walking Dead' filming locations. Since this is a private tour, you can choose the sites you would like to visit.
